'''''Allium cristophii''''', the '''Persian onion''' or '''star of Persia''',<ref>{{GRIN | accessdate = 16 December 2017}}</ref><ref>[https://www.gardening.cornell.edu/homegardening/scenec7fd.html ''Allium cristophii''] at [https://www.gardening.cornell.edu/homegardening/scenee139.html Flower Growing Guides] of [[Cornell University]]</ref> is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[family (botany)|family]] Amaryllidaceae, [[native species|native]] to [[Iran]], [[Turkey]], and [[Turkmenistan]], though grown as an ornamental [[bulb|bulbous plant]] in many parts of the world.<ref name=jen/> It may be sold under the synonym of ''Allium albopilosum''.

Star of Persia grows to {{convert|50|cm|in|abbr=on}} and is cultivated in gardens for its large showy [[umbels]] of silvery pink star-shaped flowers, {{convert|20-25|cm|in|abbr=on}} in diameter, which appear in early summer.  The flowers are followed by attractive fruiting clusters. The plant has received the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/816/Allium-cristophii/Details | title = ''Allium cristophii'' | website = www.rhs.org | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | access-date = 27 February 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = November 2018 | page = 4 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | website = www.rhs.org | access-date = 27 February 2020}}</ref>

''A. cristophii'' performs best in sun to part shade.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Allium cristophii|url=https://www.farmergracy.co.uk/products/allium-christophii-bulbs-uk|access-date=2021-06-18|website=Farmer Gracy}}</ref> It is toxic to cats and dogs.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Allium cristophii|url=https://www.gardenersworld.com/plants/allium-cristophii/|access-date=2021-06-18|website=BBC Gardeners' World Magazine|language=en}}</ref> It prefers sandy, gritty soil with good drainage, and is best suited to [[Hardiness zone|USDA hardiness zones]] 5–8.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Allium cristophii (Star of Persia)|url=https://www.gardenia.net/plant/allium-cristophii-star-of-persia|access-date=2021-06-18|website=Gardenia.net}}</ref>
